methodology: Independent approximate manual full-object silhouette traces placed by visual inspection of the union of the original 24-photo selection and frozen 60-photo selection of the same capture (62 distinct input photos) as 320x180 LANCZOS previews and enlarged input-only inspection sheets. No camera solution, reconstruction, render, training result, RGB threshold, or automatic segmentation was read or used. The entire visible sculpted head including its integral base is foreground. Table, calibration tags, room, and cast shadows are background. Shallow sculpted facial recesses retain visible object surfaces and are not holes. Uniform two-pixel Chebyshev erosion removes uncertain silhouette margins.
author: Codex GPT-6, manual image inspection
purpose: Evaluation only; never training or geometry input. Approximate annotations, not ground truth.
coordinateSystem: Normalized x/320,y/180 in the input preview; physical camera roll remains as captured.

rasterization.erosionMetric: Chebyshev; 5x5 minimum filter after polygon filling

limitations: Vertices approximate the full visible silhouette at 320px; small hair curls and boundaries differ by several pixels.
Some objects are clipped at the photograph border; only visible pixels are annotated.
A uniform two-pixel erosion removes boundary uncertainty and may remove tiny details.
These are manually approximated masks, not source-supplied or independently certified ground truth.
